data.one_liner: A Flutter styling system that separates style definitions from widget code using a fluent API.
data.what_it_does: Mix lets you define, compose, and apply visual styles to widgets outside of the build method. It supports conditional variants for hover, dark mode, breakpoints, and more.
use_when: You want a centralized, type‑safe way to manage design tokens and reusable styles
You need conditional styling (hover, dark mode, responsive) without scattering logic in widgets
avoid_when: Your app is simple and doesn’t require a separate styling layer
You prefer using the built‑in ThemeData approach
strengths: Clear separation of style and UI logic
Built‑in variant system for interaction and context
weaknesses: Adds an extra abstraction layer to learn
Limited to styling; not a full widget library

alternatives.name: flex_seed_scheme
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a theming system based on seed colors without a separate styling API
